title: Making the Most of Your Mistakes

sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: In 2009, British businessman Philip Davison Sebrey
sentences.zh: 2009年，英国商人菲利普·戴维森·塞布里

sentences.en: was celebrating his wife's 50th birthday in the Maldives
sentences.zh: 正在马尔代夫为妻子庆祝50岁生日，

sentences.en: when he got a phone call.
sentences.zh: 这时他接到了一通电话。

sentences.en: The caller asked for a business meeting the next day at 8 a.m.
sentences.zh: 对方要求第二天早上8点开个商务会议。

sentences.en: Philip explained that that would be a little difficult,
sentences.zh: 菲利普解释说这有点困难，

sentences.en: seeing as he was 4,500 miles away from work on vacation.
sentences.zh: 因为他正在度假，离公司有4500英里远。

sentences.en: What are you doing away at a time like this?
sentences.zh: “这种时候你不在公司在干什么？”

sentences.en: The voice at the other end of the line shouted,
Philip thought it was a joke in poor taste.
sentences.zh: 菲利普以为这是一个恶劣的玩笑。

sentences.en: In an interview with Wales Online,
sentences.zh: 在接受《威尔士在线》采访时，

sentences.en: he recalled that the caller assured him that it was no joking matter.
sentences.zh: 他回忆说，对方坚称这绝非儿戏。

sentences.en: A British government agency had reported the demise
sentences.zh: 英国政府的一个机构发布了

sentences.en: of Philip's 134-year-old engineering company, Taylor & Sons.
sentences.zh: 菲利普那家拥有134年历史的工程公司——泰勒父子公司的倒闭公告。

sentences.en: The government agency, known as Companies House,
sentences.zh: 这个名为“公司注册处”的政府机构，

sentences.en: serves as a kind of registrar for British businesses.
sentences.zh: 相当于英国企业的注册登记部门。

sentences.en: It said that Taylor & Sons, created in 1875,
sentences.zh: 它声称创建于1875年的泰勒父子公司

sentences.en: Turns out, a government clerk had made a typo.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，是一名政府职员打字打错了。

sentences.en: The company that was going out of business

sentences.zh: 是曼彻斯特的泰勒父子公司，
而不是威尔士的泰勒父子公司。

sentences.en: His company had been doing well.
sentences.zh: 他的公司一直经营得很好。

sentences.en: Within days, he later said in that interview with Wales Online,
sentences.zh: 他在后来接受《威尔士在线》采访时说，几天之内，

sentences.en: The government agency did correct the mistake after some days,
sentences.zh: 虽然几天后政府机构纠正了错误，

sentences.en: but a debt spiral had taken hold.
In time, Taylor & Sons actually did go out of business.
sentences.zh: 最终，泰勒父子公司真的倒闭了。

sentences.en: Not all errors are so consequential.
sentences.zh: 并非所有的错误都会带来如此严重的后果。

sentences.en: But some are deadly, and many have unpredictable effects.
sentences.zh: 但有些错误是致命的，而且许多错误会产生不可预见的影响。

sentences.en: Wouldn't we all prefer that governments, organizations, and companies
sentences.zh: 难道我们不都希望政府、组织和公司
这是一种可以理解的反应。

sentences.en: But it turns out that demanding no errors
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，要求零错误

sentences.en: might be the biggest mistake of all.
When people work on things, mistakes are inevitable.
sentences.zh: 当人们做事时，错误是不可避免的。

sentences.en: This is true in our personal lives, in our workplaces,
sentences.zh: 这在我们的个人生活、工作场所

sentences.en: and at the level of public policy.
sentences.zh: 以及公共政策层面都是如此。

sentences.en: Not all mistakes are created equal, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，并非所有的错误都是一样的。

sentences.en: Some failures are trivial, while others can be disastrous.
sentences.zh: 有些失误微不足道，而有些则可能造成灾难。

sentences.en: At Harvard Business School, Amy Edmondson studies how failures come about
sentences.zh: 在哈佛商学院，艾米·埃德蒙森研究失败是如何产生的，

sentences.en: and what we can do about them.
sentences.zh: 以及我们能为此做些什么。

sentences.en: She has surprising insights into how organizations and people
sentences.zh: 她对组织和个人应该如何看待自己所犯的错误，

sentences.en: should think about the mistakes they make.
Amy Edmondson, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 艾米·埃德蒙森，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
Amy, as a young scientist working on your first major research project,
sentences.zh: 艾米，作为一名年轻的科学家，在进行你的第一个重大研究项目时，

sentences.en: you spent months collecting data from doctors and nurses at two local hospitals.
sentences.zh: 你花了几个月的时间从两家当地医院的医生和护士那里收集数据。

sentences.en: I understand that you were tracking medical mistakes?
sentences.zh: 我理解你当时是在追踪医疗事故？

sentences.en: Yes, we call them adverse drug events.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们称之为药物不良事件。

sentences.en: So that is when something bad happens to a patient
sentences.zh: 也就是当病人发生了一些不好的事情，

sentences.en: that is deemed caused by human error.
sentences.zh: 被认为是由人为错误引起的时候。

sentences.en: And so I would get a phone call from one of the physicians in the study
sentences.zh: 所以我经常会接到研究中某位医生的电话，

sentences.en: who would say, there's just been an event,
sentences.zh: 他们会说，刚刚发生了一起事件，

sentences.en: and so we're going to take a look at what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要去看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: And so I would hop on my bike and ride down to the hospital,
sentences.zh: 于是我会骑上自行车赶往医院，

sentences.en: and I'd find myself in a conference room,
and we would then sit around and hear from the perspective of different people
sentences.zh: 我们坐在一起，听取不同人的视角，

sentences.en: who may have touched or been aware of the adverse event,
sentences.zh: 那些可能接触过或了解该不良事件的人，

sentences.en: and we try to truly understand what happened.
sentences.zh: 我们试图真正理解发生了什么。

sentences.en: So for instance, in one case,
there was a patient that received a drug called lidocaine,
sentences.zh: 有一位病人接受了一种叫利多卡因的药物，

sentences.en: and they were supposed to get a drug called heparin.
sentences.zh: 而他们本应接受的是肝素。

sentences.en: Now the two drugs were labeled similarly,
sentences.zh: 这两种药的标签很相似，

sentences.en: and they were in the same location even though they do very different things.
sentences.zh: 而且它们放在同一个地方，尽管它们的作用截然不同。

sentences.en: Now in this case, the lidocaine would not hurt the patient,
sentences.zh: 在这个案例中，利多卡因不会伤害病人，

sentences.en: but the absence of heparin might have led to real harm.
sentences.zh: 但缺少肝素可能会导致真正的伤害。

sentences.en: So these adverse events didn't always involve harm,
sentences.zh: 所以这些不良事件并不总是涉及伤害，

sentences.en: but they always involved at least the potential for harm.
sentences.zh: 但它们至少总是包含伤害的可能性。

sentences.en: Now you became aware that some teams at these hospitals
sentences.zh: 你意识到这些医院里的一些团队

sentences.en: were making more errors, more mistakes than others,
sentences.zh: 比其他团队犯了更多的错误，

sentences.en: you also were examining how teams functioned,
sentences.zh: 你还在检查团队是如何运作的，

sentences.en: and you found that some teams functioned better than others.
sentences.zh: 你发现有些团队比其他团队运作得更好。

sentences.en: Tell me about the components of teamwork that you measured.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你所衡量的团队合作的组成部分。

sentences.en: Well, I used a classic team survey called the Team Diagnostic Survey,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我使用了一个经典的团队调查问卷，叫“团队诊断调查”，

sentences.en: and it measured such things as the quality of interpersonal relationships in the team,
sentences.zh: 它衡量了诸如团队中人际关系的质量、

sentences.en: the team's own self-assessment of how well they were performing,
sentences.zh: 团队对自己表现的自我评估、

sentences.en: the team's assessment of whether and the degree to which they had the resources they need to do their job well,
sentences.zh: 团队对是否拥有完成工作所需资源及其程度的评估，

sentences.en: especially interested in their assessment of the leadership of the team
sentences.zh: 我特别关注他们对团队领导力的评估，

sentences.en: and how good was that leadership.
sentences.zh: 以及这种领导力有多好。

sentences.en: And these are a set of factors that had been previously recognized as important to team effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 这些因素此前已被公认为对团队效能很重要。

sentences.en: And you were also looking at how much people cared about their work
sentences.zh: 你当时也在观察人们有多关心他们的工作，

sentences.en: and whether people felt like everyone was pulling their fair share of the weight.
sentences.zh: 以及人们是否觉得每个人都分担了公平的责任。

sentences.en: Yes, and I think that assessment is partly captured in the quality of relationships measure,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这种评估部分体现在人际关系质量的衡量中，

sentences.en: but there also was the measures of their satisfaction with the work,
sentences.zh: 但也有对工作满意度的衡量，

sentences.en: how happy they were in their job.
sentences.zh: 他们在工作中有多快乐。

sentences.en: And all of these measures tend to travel together.
sentences.zh: 所有这些衡量指标往往是同步变化的。

sentences.en: So in a good team, in a well-led team, they tend to be high on all of these factors.
sentences.zh: 所以在一个优秀的团队中，在一个领导有方的团队中，这些因素的得分往往都很高。

sentences.en: In a not good team, they're low on all of these factors.
sentences.zh: 在一个表现不佳的团队中，这些因素的得分都很低。

sentences.en: So you now have two sets of data, information on high-performing teams versus low-performing teams,
sentences.zh: 所以你现在有两组数据，关于高绩效团队与低绩效团队的信息，

sentences.en: and information on teams that make few mistakes or lots of mistakes.
sentences.zh: 以及关于犯错少或犯错多的团队的信息。

sentences.en: I mean, it seems quite obvious what the answer is going to be,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，答案似乎显而易见，

sentences.en: but what was your intuition about how the quality of teams would relate to the mistakes that teams were making?
sentences.zh: 但你对于团队质量与团队所犯错误之间关系的直觉是什么？

sentences.en: Well, my intuition was that better teamwork would lead to fewer mistakes or adverse events for patients.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的直觉是，更好的团队合作会减少病人的错误或不良事件。

sentences.en: And the more I understood about the nature of patient care in a hospital,
sentences.zh: 我对医院病人护理的本质了解得越多，

sentences.en: the more I realized how interdependent it was.
sentences.zh: 就越意识到它是多么相互依赖。

sentences.en: First of all, it's 24-7 operations, so there's shift handoffs.
sentences.zh: 首先，这是24小时全天候运作，所以有轮班交接。

sentences.en: And second of all, most patients are seen by multiple different caregivers through the course of their stay.
sentences.zh: 其次，大多数病人在住院期间会由多位不同的护理人员照看。

sentences.en: And so the quality of the coordination and the collaboration
sentences.zh: 因此，协调和协作的质量

sentences.en: ought to really determine the degree to which high-quality care is given.
sentences.zh: 应该真正决定了提供高质量护理的程度。

sentences.en: So, of course, I expected better teams would have fewer adverse events or mistakes.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当然预期更好的团队会有更少的不良事件或错误。

sentences.en: So the day comes when you're ready to analyze all of the data.
sentences.zh: 那么，到了你准备分析所有数据的那一天。

sentences.en: You have a small computer disk with all the medication errors made by each team.
sentences.zh: 你手里有一张小电脑磁盘，记录了每个团队所犯的所有用药错误。

sentences.en: Paint me a picture of what happened that day, Amy.
sentences.zh: 艾米，给我描绘一下那天发生了什么。

sentences.en: Well, I synced up the data on the disk with the data that I already had on the team properties in my computer
sentences.zh: 嗯，我把磁盘上的数据与我电脑里已有的团队属性数据进行了同步，

sentences.en: and started to run the statistical analysis to connect those two data sources.
sentences.zh: 并开始运行统计分析来连接这两个数据源。

sentences.en: And I just ran some simple correlations, and I saw right away that the p-value,
sentences.zh: 我运行了一些简单的相关性分析，立刻看到p值，

sentences.en: which indicates whether or not the finding is statistically significant,
sentences.zh: 它指示研究结果是否具有统计学意义，

sentences.en: I saw that the p-value indicated that my data were statistically significant.
sentences.zh: 我看到p值表明我的数据具有统计学意义。

sentences.en: And then I looked more closely, leaning into the screen,
sentences.zh: 然后我凑近屏幕仔细看，

sentences.en: and I realized that the sign was in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 我意识到符号的方向反了。

sentences.en: In other words, instead of seeing a relationship between good teamwork and low error rates,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我看到的不是良好的团队合作与低错误率之间的关系，

sentences.en: the statistical significance was saying there was a relationship between good teamwork
sentences.zh: 统计学意义显示的是良好的团队合作
与高错误率之间的关系。

sentences.en: How could that possibly be, Amy?
I was upset, and I was scared.
And so I sat there looking at it.
sentences.zh: 所以我坐在那里盯着它看。

sentences.en: And my first reaction was, I must have made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 我的第一反应是，我一定犯了错误。

sentences.en: I must have put the data in incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 我一定把数据录入错了。

sentences.en: So I walked very carefully through everything I'd done.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常仔细地检查了我所做的一切。

sentences.en: And nope, maybe my hypothesis had been a mistake,
sentences.zh: 没有，也许我的假设错了，

sentences.en: but I had not made a kind of data entry mistake.
sentences.zh: 但我并没有犯那种数据录入错误。

sentences.en: And so there I was, staring at it again and again, puzzled.
sentences.zh: 所以我就坐在那里，一遍又一遍地盯着它看，感到困惑。

sentences.en: It can't be that better teams with higher quality relationships,
sentences.zh: 不可能说拥有更高质量关系、

sentences.en: more able and willing to collaborate effectively,
sentences.zh: 更有能力且更愿意有效协作、

sentences.en: to coordinate clearly, could have more, not fewer adverse drug events.
sentences.zh: 清晰协调的优秀团队，反而会有更多而不是更少的药物不良事件。

sentences.en: And I suddenly had a thought.
You know, maybe better teams don't make more mistakes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许优秀的团队并不是犯了更多的错误。

sentences.en: Maybe they're more able and willing to report them.
sentences.zh: 也许他们更有能力且更愿意报告这些错误。

sentences.en: And I suddenly remembered that I had inserted an extra question
sentences.zh: 我突然想起我加了一个额外的问题。

sentences.en: that wasn't in the original survey that is stated as follows.
sentences.zh: 那不在最初的调查问卷中，具体表述如下。

sentences.en: If you make a mistake in this unit, it's held against you.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个部门犯了错，就会被追究责任。

sentences.en: And it's rated on a seven-point scale from, you know, not at all to a great deal.
sentences.zh: 它采用七分制进行评估，你知道，从完全不追究到非常严重。

sentences.en: And it turned out that that single item
sentences.zh: 结果发现，那单一的一项指标

sentences.en: was profoundly significantly correlated with the actual error rates.
sentences.zh: 与实际错误率有着极其显著的相关性。

sentences.en: So that meant that when people agreed with this item,
sentences.zh: 这意味着，当人们同意这一项时，

sentences.en: making a mistake would not be held against you,
sentences.zh: 即“犯错不会被追究责任”，

sentences.en: That is not, you know, a perfect proof,
sentences.zh: 这当然算不上什么完美的证据，

sentences.en: but it certainly suggested that there was something in the climate of the team
sentences.zh: 但它确实表明团队氛围中存在某种因素，

sentences.en: that would make it easier to speak up about and report error.
sentences.zh: 能让人更容易开口谈论并报告错误。

sentences.en: So you hired a research assistant to actually go to the hospital
sentences.zh: 于是你雇了一名研究助理去医院，

sentences.en: and observe firsthand how teams at the hospital were functioning,
sentences.zh: 亲身观察医院团队的运作方式，

sentences.en: testing this hypothesis that better teams, in fact,
sentences.zh: 以验证这一假设：事实上，更好的团队

sentences.en: were more willing to report the mistakes.
And that's why they were showing up as having committed greater numbers of mistakes.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他们表现出的错误数量更多。

sentences.en: What did the research assistant find?
Well, first of all, I think it's important to point out
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我认为有一点很重要，

sentences.en: that I did not tell him what the survey data said,
sentences.zh: 我并没有告诉他调查数据说了什么，

sentences.en: nor what the error data said.
sentences.zh: 也没告诉他错误数据说了什么。

sentences.en: He only knew that there was a study of error going on.
sentences.zh: 他只知道有一项关于错误的研究正在进行。

sentences.en: And I said, I just want your impression
sentences.zh: 我对他说，我只想知道你的印象，

sentences.en: of what it's like to work in these units.
sentences.zh: 在这些部门工作是什么感觉。

sentences.en: I want you to observe them.
I want you to interview them when they're on breaks
sentences.zh: 我希望你在他们休息时采访他们，

sentences.en: and just, you know, learn as much as you can
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽可能多地去了解

sentences.en: And after a week or so, he came back.
He said, you know, they really are very different places to work.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，这些地方的工作环境确实非常不同。

sentences.en: Some of them, he said, his words were just far more open.
sentences.zh: 他说，有些部门，用他的话说是要开放得多。

sentences.en: And others, he said, again, his words were authoritarian in nature.
sentences.zh: 而另一些部门，他再次强调，本质上是威权式的。

sentences.en: In some units, people would say things like,
if you make a mistake in this unit, you get treated like a two-year-old
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个部门犯了错，就会被像对待两岁小孩一样对待，

sentences.en: or you get put on trial.
So you really don't want to have made one.
Or the nurse manager, who is essentially the boss of the unit,
sentences.zh: 或者护士长，也就是部门主管，

sentences.en: if you're a nurse, would get angry and treat you badly.
sentences.zh: 如果你是护士，她会发火并恶劣地对待你。

sentences.en: In other units, even though they're only maybe across the hall
sentences.zh: 而在其他部门，尽管可能就在走廊对面，

sentences.en: or up a floor or two, he found people saying things like,
sentences.zh: 或者只隔了一两层楼，他发现人们会说，

sentences.en: well, in this unit, it's really easy to talk about mistakes
sentences.zh: 嗯，在这个部门，谈论错误真的很容易，
因为这关系到重大利益。

sentences.en: You know, a patient's health is at stake.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这关系到病人的健康。

sentences.en: So, of course, you're never afraid to speak up
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，你永远不必害怕开口，

sentences.en: and you're never afraid to tell the nurse manager about what you see.
sentences.zh: 也永远不必害怕告诉护士长你所看到的一切。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how this insight started to change your thinking
sentences.zh: 艾米，我想知道这种洞察力是如何开始改变你对错误和失败本质的看法的。

sentences.en: about the nature of mistakes and failure, Amy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我意识到你无法从那些

sentences.en: Well, to begin with, I realized you can't learn from mistakes
sentences.zh: 未被报告的错误中学习。
当我们思考组织和团队，

sentences.en: When we think about organizations and teams
sentences.zh: 以及从错误和失败中学习的目标时，

sentences.en: and the goal of learning from mistakes and learning from failures,
sentences.zh: 首要任务是确保我们确实在

sentences.en: job one is to make sure we're actually talking about them

sentences.zh: 这让我开始思考，工作环境之间可能存在差异，

sentences.en: And so that started me thinking that maybe there are differences
sentences.zh: 也就是我当时所说的人际氛围。

sentences.en: in work environments in what I called then interpersonal climate.
And if the interpersonal climate differs,
sentences.zh: 那将对人们从错误和失败中学习的能力

sentences.en: that would have real implications for people's ability
